source: Data from the public linux.do API (anonymous, read-only)
errorNetwork: Network request failed. Check your network and proxy, then retry
errorRate: Too many requests. Please try again later
errorBlocked: Blocked by the Cloudflare challenge. Paste your browser's cf_clearance and User-Agent (as a pair) in Settings
settingsClearancePlaceholder: Paste the cf_clearance value from your browser
settingsUaPlaceholder: Paste your browser's navigator.userAgent; leave empty for the default {default}
settingsTestBlocked: Still challenged (HTTP {status}) — make sure cookie and UA come from the same browser and your exit IP has not changed
settingsHowStep1: 1. Open linux.do in the browser you normally use and pass the challenge once;
settingsHowStep2: 2. DevTools → Application → Cookies → linux.do, copy the cf_clearance value;
settingsHowStep3: 3. DevTools → Console, run navigator.userAgent and copy the full output;
settingsHowStep4: 4. Paste both values here and save. Repeat when it expires.
settingsAboutBody: This plugin browses linux.do anonymously and read-only: categories, topics and replies come from the public Discourse JSON API. No login, posting, replying or any write operation.
settingsPrivacy: cf_clearance and the UA are stored only in this webview's localStorage and can be cleared anytime; the plugin never sends your data to third parties.
settingsPairHint: cf_clearance and the User-Agent must be pasted as a pair: either one alone will be rejected by Cloudflare
